mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM ( SELECT @ids AS _ids, ( SELECT @ids := GROUP_CONCAT( id ) FROM SYS_ORG WHERE FIND_IN_SET( PARENT_ID, @ids ) ) AS cids, @l := @l + 1 AS LEVEL FROM SYS_ORG, ( SELECT @ids := ${orgId}, @l := 0 ) b WHERE @ids IS NOT NULL ) b, SYS_ORG a WHERE FIND_IN_SET( a.id, b._ids ) ORDER BY LEVEL, id
SELECT * FROM SYS_ORG ORDER BY SORT_CODE ASC
